title: Arm Future Maneuver Burns
summary: Made future maneuver burns arm and count down instead of instantly jumping the spacecraft to the node.

title: Maneuver Alignment Guidance
summary: Added burn-vector alignment guidance, ignition timing, and pointing error readouts so planned nodes connect directly to spacecraft attitude.

title: Direct Maneuver Node Placement
summary: Added click-to-place maneuver nodes on the orbit line, scene markers, map connectors, and a maneuver cue on the navball.

title: Intuitive Maneuver Node Editor
summary: Added a MechJeb-style maneuver editor with prograde, normal, radial, TIG, AP/PE placement, predicted orbit, and burn timing.

title: Maneuver Planning And Flight Display Controls
summary: Added the first maneuver planning pass with flight display controls, predicted orbit telemetry, and burn execution.

title: Roadmap For Clean CRT Display Target
summary: Updated the roadmap around a clean CRT display target and Apollo mission-control visual direction.

title: Apollo Cockpit Display And Flight Rendering
summary: Reworked the interface around Apollo mission-control references with clean lines, compact telemetry, and an updateable node editor.

title: Earth With Vector Grid And Coastlines
summary: Added vector Earth grid and coastline rendering for clearer orbital position and horizon reference.
